# AI metadata parser test fixtures

Synthetic, benign-content fixtures generated by `dist/gen_ai_fixtures.py`.
`mIV tool` / `mIV models` are the *actual* shipped-parser output
(`png_metadata::extract_metadata` + `model_names`), captured for regression.
